description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeTerminationAPI class in the OrangeHRM system. It tests functionalities such as deleting, retrieving, creating, and updating employee termination records, along with validation rules. It uses mock objects and fixtures to simulate various scenarios and verify correct behavior of the API methods.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeTerminationAPI, testing CRUD operations, validation, and error handling.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads initial fixture data for testing by populating the database with predefined employee termination records.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the deletion of an employee termination record and verifies the response and exception handling.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies the validation rules for the delete operation based on user permissions.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Ensures that the getAll method is not implemented and raises the expected exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the getAll operation, expecting not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific employee termination record and handling not found exceptions.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Checks validation rules for fetching one record, based on employee number and record ID.

methods.name: testCreateWithRecordNotFound
methods.description: Tests creating a termination record when the employee does not exist, expecting a not found exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of an employee termination record and verifies the returned data structure.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates rules for creating a termination record, ensuring proper input validation.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee termination record and verifies the result.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for updating a termination record.
